title: Piano Improvisations Vol. 1
notes:
Recorded on April 21 and 22, 1971 at the Bendiksen Studio, Oslo

This release has:
.  " © COPYRIGHT 1971 BY ECM "  on back cover
.  NO " PRINTED in W. GERMANY " mention on back cover
.  NO " MADE IN GERMANY " mention on center labels

Not as otherwise similar [r7701159] which has:
. " ℗ 1970 ECM Records GmbH " on back cover
. " PRINTED in W. GERMANY " at bottom right of back cover
. " MADE IN GERMANY "  on center labels
